versions.subject: feat: add more rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'netsh.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # Example 1: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule "group=\"Network Discovery\" " new enable=Yes"
        # Example 2: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule "group=\"File and Printer Sharing\" " new enable=Yes"
        - ' firewall '
        - ' set '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\netsh.exe" OR OriginalFileName="netsh.exe" CommandLine="* firewall *" CommandLine="* set *"
